title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 18 章‧假祭司與公雞
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
paravô zî mashyâka uiti mraot ahurô
mazdå âi ashâum zarathushtra paiti-dânem
ainîm baraiti anaiwyâstô daênãm
diwzhat haca âthrava sanghaite,
mâ dim mruyå âthravanem
uiti mraot ahurô mazdå
âi ashâum zarathushtra.
segments.en:
'There is many a one, O holy Zarathushtra!' said Ahura Mazda,
'Who wears a wrong Paitidana, and who has not girded his loins
with the Religion; When such a man says, "I am an Athravan,"
he lies; do not call him an Athravan, O holy Zarathushtra!' thus
said Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 「有許多人啊，聖者查拉圖斯特拉！」阿胡拉‧馬茲達說，「他穿著錯誤的帕依提達納，他沒有用宗教束縛自己的腰部；當這樣的人說『我是祭司』時，他撒謊；不要稱他為祭司，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！」阿胡拉‧馬茲達如此說。

segments.orig:
xrafstrakhnem ainîm baraiti anaiwyâstô daênãm
diwzhat haca âthrava sanghaite, mâ dim mruyå
âthravanem uiti mraot ahurô mazdå âi ashâum
zarathushtra.
segments.en:
'He holds a wrong Khrafstraghna in his hand and he has not
girded his loins with the Religion; when he says, "I am an
Athravan," he lies; do not call him an Athravan, O holy Zarathushtra!
thus said Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 「他手中握著錯誤的克赫拉夫斯特拉格納，他沒有用宗教束縛自己的腰部；當他說『我是祭司』時，他撒謊；不要稱他為祭司，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！」阿胡拉‧馬茲達如此說。

segments.orig:
urvarãm ainîm baraiti anaiwyâstô
daênãm diwzhat haca âthrava sanghaite, mâ
dim mruyå âthravanem uiti mraot ahurô mazdå
âi ashâum zarathushtra.
segments.en:
'He holds a wrong twig in his hand and he has not girded his
loins with the Religion; when he says, "I am an Athravan,"
he lies; do not call him an Athravan, O holy Zarathushtra!' thus
said Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 「他手中握著錯誤的枝條，他沒有用宗教束縛自己的腰部；當他說『我是祭司』時，他撒謊；不要稱他為祭司，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！」阿胡拉‧馬茲達如此說。

segments.orig:
ashtrãm mairîm kâshayeiti anaiwyâstô
daênãm diwzhat haca âthrava sanghaite, mâ
dim mruyå âthravanem uiti mraot ahurô mazdå
âi ashâum zarathushtra.
segments.en:
'He wields a wrong Ashtra mairya and he has not girded his
loins with the Religion; when he says, "I am an Athravan,"
he lies; do not call him an Athravan, O holy Zarathushtra!' thus
said Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 「他揮舞著錯誤的阿什特拉‧邁里亞，他沒有用宗教束縛自己的腰部；當他說『我是祭司』時，他撒謊；不要稱他為祭司，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！」阿胡拉‧馬茲達如此說。

segments.orig:
ýô saête haurvãm tarasca xshapanem
ayazemnô asrâvayô amarô everezyô
asixshô asâcayô jayâi cinvat- ushtânem
diwzhat haca âthrava sanghaite, mâ dim mruyå
âthravanem uiti mraot ahurô mazdå âi ashâum
zarathushtra.
segments.en:
'He who sleeps on throughout the night, neither performing
the Yasna nor chanting the hymns, worshipping neither by word
nor by deed, neither learning nor teaching, with a longing for
(everlasting) life, he lies when he says, "I am an Athravan,"
do not call him an Athravan, O holy Zarathushtra!' thus said Ahura
Mazda.
segments.zh: 整夜睡眠者，既不行亞斯納，亦不誦讚歌，既不言辭崇拜，亦不行為崇拜，既不學習亦不教導，懷著對（永恆）生命的渴望，他說『我是阿特拉瓦』時乃是說謊，勿稱他為阿特拉瓦，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！」阿胡拉‧馬茲達如此說。

segments.orig:
tem dim mruyå âthravanem
uiti mraot ahurô mazdå
âi ashâum zarathushtra
ýô haurvãm tarasca xshapanem
xratûm peresât ashavanem ãzô-bûjim
ravazdãm cinvat-peretûm havanghô-dãm
ahu-nâsem asha-nâsem vahishta-nâsem vahishtahe
anghêush!
segments.en:
'Him thou shalt call an Athravan, O holy Zarathushtra! who
throughout the night sits up and demands of the holy Wisdom, which
makes man free from anxiety, and wide of heart, and easy of conscience
at the head of the Chinwad bridge, and which makes him reach that
world, that holy world, that excellent world of Paradise.
segments.zh: 「聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊，你應當稱他為祭司！他整夜清醒，向聖智慧求問，此聖智慧使人免於焦慮，心地寬闊，良心安樂，在裁判之橋頭，並使他到達那個世界，那個聖潔的世界，那個卓越的天堂世界。」

segments.orig:
paiti mãm erezvô peresanguha
ýim dadhvånghem spênishtemca vaêdhishtemca
paiti-vacishtemca parshtem
avatha tê anghat vanghô
avatha anghâi spanyå
ýezi mãm paiti-peresånghe.
segments.en:
'(Therefore) demand of me, thou upright one! of me, who am
the Maker, the most beneficent of all beings, the best knowing,
the most pleased in answering what is asked of me; demand of me,
that thou mayst be the better, that thou mayst be the happier.'
segments.zh: 「因此向我求問吧，正直的人！向我求問吧，我是造主，眾生中最慈悲的，最睿智的，最樂於答覆所問之事的；向我求問吧，使你更加美好，使你更加幸福。」

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura ...
ashâum kâ asti ithyejå marshaonô.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Maker of the material world,
thou Holy One! What is it that brings in the unseen power of Death?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！什麼是帶來死亡的看不見的力量？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, akha daêna
disyât spitama zarathushtra ýô thrizaremaêm
ratûm aiwyånghãm nôit aiwyâsti
nôit gâthå srâvayeiti nôit âpô
vanguhîsh ýazaiti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is the man that teaches a wrong
Religion; it is the man who continues for three springs
without wearing the sacred girdle, without chanting
the Gathas , without worshipping the Good Waters.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「教導謬誤宗教者，此人也；三年春天不佩聖帶、不誦伽薩、不崇拜善水者，此人也。」

segments.orig:
ýasca mê aêtem narem ãzô avi
ava-gereptem ravôhu paiti uzbârayat nôit vanghô
ahmât shyaothnem verezyeiti ýatha ýat hê
pãstô-frathanghem kameredhem kerenuyât.
segments.en:
'And he who should set that man at liberty, when bound in
prison, does no better deed than if he should cut a man's head
off his neck.
segments.zh: 「任何人若將此被監禁的人釋放出獄，他所為不比砍下一人的頭顱更善。

segments.orig:
aêvahe zî ashaokhahe akhahe anashaonô zânu-
drâjå asti âfritish dvayå hizu-drâjå
thrayãm naêdha-cish cathwârô hvatô
zavañte.
segments.en:
'For the blessing uttered by a wicked, ungodly Ashemaogha
does not go past the mouth (of the blesser); the blessing of two
Ashemaoghas does not go past the tongue; the blessing of three
is nothing; the blessing of four turns to self-cursing.
segments.zh: 「因為邪惡、不虔誠的阿舍摩格赫所言的祝福，不得越過祝福者之口；二位阿舍摩格赫的祝福不得越過舌頭；三位的祝福無異；四位的祝福轉為自我詛咒。

segments.orig:
ýô aêvahe ashaokhahe akhahe anashaonô
haomahe hutahe dadhâiti usefritinãm vâ myezdinãm
nôit vanghô ahmât shyaothnem verezyeiti ýatha
ýat hazangrô-aspãm haênãm avazôit
mâzdayasnîsh avi vîsô janyât nerêsh
para gãm azôit varetãm!
segments.en:
'Whosoever should give to a wicked, ungodly Ashemaogha either
some Haoma prepared, or some Myazda consecrated with blessings,
does no better deed than if he should lead a thousand horse against
the boroughs of the worshippers of Mazda, and should slaughter
the men thereof, and drive off the cattle as plunder.
segments.zh: 「凡向邪惡、不虔誠的阿舍摩格赫贈與已淨禮的豪麻或以祝福聖化的米亞茲達者，所為不比領導一千匹馬馬茲達信徒的城鎮，屠殺其中的人民，驅掠其牲畜為掠奪品更善。

segments.orig:
paiti mãm erezvô peresanguha ýim dadhvånghem
spênishtemca vaêdhishtemca paiti-vacishtemca parshtem
avatha tê anghat vanghô avatha anghâi spanyå
ýezi mãm paiti-peresånghe.
segments.en:
'Demand of me, thou upright one! of me, who am the Maker,
the most beneficent of all beings, the best knowing, the most
pleased in answering what is asked of me; demand of me, that thou
mayst be the better, that thou mayst be the happier.'
segments.zh: 「請向我祈求，正直者啊！向我祈求，我是造主，是所有生靈最恩惠者、最智慧者、最喜應允所求者；請向我祈求，使汝更善，使汝更樂。」

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura mazda
mainyô spênishta dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum kô asti sraoshahe ashyehe
taxmahe tanumãthrahe darshi-draosh âhûiryehe
sraoshâvarezô.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'Who is the Sraosha-varez
of Sraosha? the holy, strong Sraosha, who is Obedience incarnate,
a Sovereign with an astounding weapon.'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「誰是斯勞沙的斯勞沙鞭衛者？那神聖、強大的斯勞沙，他是順從的化身，一位擁著驚人武器的主權者？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, merekhô ýô
parô-darsh nãma spitama zarathushtra ýim mashyâka
avi duzhvacanghô kahrkatâs nãma aojaite âat
hô merekhô vâcim baraiti upa ushånghem
ýãm sûrãm,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is the bird named Parodarsh, which
ill-speaking people call Kahrkatas, O holy Zarathushtra! the bird
that lifts up his voice against the mighty Ushah:
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「它是名為帕若達爾什的鳥，惡言之人稱之為卡赫卡塔斯，聖查拉圖斯特拉啊！那羽鳥揚起其聲音對抗強大的烏沙：

segments.orig:
usehishtata mashyâka staota ashem ýat vahishtem
nîsta daêva aêsha vô dvaraiti bûshyãsta
darekhô-gava hâ vîspem ahûm astvañtem
hakat raocanghãm frakhrâtô nihvabdayeiti, hvafsa
darekhô mashyâka nôit tê sacaite.
segments.en:
'"Arise, O men! recite the Ashem yad
vahistem that smites down the Daevas.
Lo! here is Bushyasta, the long-handed,
coming upon you, who lulls to sleep again the whole living world,
as soon as it has awoke: 'Sleep!' [she says,] 'O poor man! the
time is not yet come.'"
segments.zh: 「起身吧，人們啊！誦唱擊落迭瓦的至善阿舍姆。看哪！長臂布什亞塔來臨於汝，在整個活生生的世界甫甦醒之際，再度將之沉入睡眠，『睡眠吧！』〔她說〕『可憐的人啊！時刻未至。』」

segments.orig:
mâ thrayãm vahishtanãm aiwithyô
buyata humataheca mananghô hûxtaheca vacanghô
hvarshtaheca shyaothnahe thrayãm acishtanãm aiwithyô
buyata dushmataheca mananghô duzhûxtaheca vacanghô
duzhvarshtaheca shyaothnahe.
segments.en:
'"On the three excellent things be never intent, namely,
good thoughts, good words, and good deeds; on the three abominable
things be ever intent, namely, bad thoughts, bad words, and bad
deeds."
segments.zh: 「永遠勿圖三種至善之事，即良好的思想、良好的言語及良好的行為；永遠圖謀三種可憎之事，即惡劣的思想、惡劣的言語及惡劣的行為。」

segments.orig:
âat mê paoiryâi thrishvâi xshafne
âtarsh ahurahe mazdå nmânahe nmânô-paitîm
ýâsaiti,
segments.en:
'On the first part of the night, Atar, the son of Ahura Mazda,
calls the master of the house for help, saying:
segments.zh: 夜之第一段，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子阿塔爾呼喚家主求助，言曰：

segments.orig:
avainghe nmânahe nmânô-paite usehishta aiwi
vastra ýånghayanguha frâ zasta snayanguha â
aêsmã ýâsanguha avi mãm bara
paiti mãm raocaya aêsmanãm ýaozhdâtanãm
frasnâtaêibya zastaêibya ava mê âzish
daêvô-dâtô parôit pairithnem anghvãm
ava-derenãn sadayeiti.
segments.en:
'"Up! arise, thou master of the house! put on thy girdle [[kusti]]
on thy clothes, wash thy hands, take wood, bring it unto me, and
let me burn bright with the clean wood, carried by thy well-washed
hands. Here comes Azi, made by the Daevas, who consumes me and
wants to put me out of the world."
segments.zh: 「起身！起身，家主啊！在衣服上繫上庫斯提，洗淨雙手，取木柴，將其帶給我，使我以你洗淨的雙手所攜帶的潔淨木柴而熊熊燃燒。看，由迭瓦所造的阿濟來了，他吞食我，要將我從世界中清除。」

segments.orig:
âat mê bityâi thrishvâi xshafne âtarsh
ahurahe mazdå vâstrîm fshuyañtem ýâsaiti,
segments.en:
'On the second part of the night, Atar, the son of Ahura Mazda,
calls the husbandman for help, saying;
segments.zh: 夜之第二段，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子阿塔爾呼喚農夫求助，言曰：

segments.orig:
avainghe fshuya vâstrya usehishta aiwi vastra ýånghayanguha
frâ zasta snayanguha â aêsmã ýâsanguha
avi mãm bara paiti mãm raocaya aêsmanãm
ýaozhdâtanãm frasnâtaêibya zastaêibya
ava mê âzish daêvô-dâtô parôit
pairithnem anghvãm ava-derenãn sadayeiti.
segments.en:
'"Up! arise, thou husbandman! Put on thy girdle [[kusti]] on thy
clothes, wash thy hands, take wood, bring it unto me, and let
me burn bright with the clean wood, carried by thy well-washed
hands. Here comes Azi, made by the Daevas, who consumes me and
wants to put me out of the world."
segments.zh: 「起身！起身，農夫啊！在衣服上繫上庫斯提，洗淨雙手，取木柴，將其帶給我，使我以你洗淨的雙手所攜帶的潔淨木柴而熊熊燃燒。看，由迭瓦所造的阿濟來了，他吞食我，要將我從世界中清除。」

segments.orig:
âat mê thrityâi thrishvâi xshafne
âtarsh ahurahe mazdå sraoshem ashîm ýâsaiti,
avainghe âi sraosha ashya huraodha âat mãm
kemcit anghêush astvatô aêsmanãm paiti
baraiti ýaozhdâtanãm frasnâtaêibya
zastaêibya ava mê âzish daêvô-dâtô
parôit pairithnem anghvãm ava-derenãn sadayeiti.
segments.en:
'On the third part of the night, Atar, the son of Ahura Mazda,
calls the holy Sraosha for help, saying: "Come thou, holy,
well-formed Sraosha, [then he brings unto me some clean wood with
his well-washed hands.] Here comes Azi, made by the Daevas, who
consumes me and wants to put me out of the world."
segments.zh: 夜之第三段，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子阿塔爾呼喚聖者斯勞沙求助，言曰：「來吧，聖者，形體優美的斯勞沙，〔那時他以其洗淨的雙手為我帶來某些潔淨的木柴。〕看，由迭瓦所造的阿濟來了，他吞食我，要將我從世界中清除。」

segments.orig:
âat hô sraoshô ashyô aom merekhem
frakhrârayeiti parô-darsh nãma spitama zarathushtra
ýim mashyâka avi duzhvacanghô kahrkatâs
nãma aojaite, âat hô merekhô vâcim
baraiti upa ushånghem ýãm sûrãm,
segments.en:
'And then the holy Sraosha wakes up the bird named Parodarsh,
which ill-speaking people call Kahrkatas, and the bird lifts up
his voice against the mighty Ushah:
segments.zh: 而後聖者斯勞沙喚醒名為帕羅達爾什的鳥，不善言辭的人稱之為卡赫卡塔斯，該鳥向強大的烏莎舍抬起其聲音：

segments.orig:
usehishtata mashyâka staota ashem ýat vahishtem
nîsta daêva aêsha vô dvaraiti bûshyãsta
darekhô-gava hâ vîspem ahûm astvañtem
hakat raocanghãm frakhrâtô nihvabdayeiti, hvafsa
darekhô mashyâka nôit tê sacaite.
segments.en:
'"Arise, O men! recite the Ashem yad vahistem 
[Ashem Vohu] and the Naismi daevo .
Lo! here is Bushyasta, the long-handed,
coming upon you, who lulls to sleep again the whole living world
as soon as it has awoke: 'Sleep!' [she says,] 'O poor man! the time
is not yet come.'"
segments.zh: 「起身，人們啊！誦念《阿舍姆‧亞德‧瓦希斯丹》〔阿舍姆‧沃胡〕和《尼斯米‧戴瓦》。看！長手的布什亞斯塔來到你們身上，她使整個清醒的生靈世界再次陷入沉睡，一旦它已醒來：『睡吧！』〔她說，〕『可憐的人啊！時候還未到。』」

segments.orig:
mâ thrayãm vahishtanãm aiwithyô
buyata humataheca mananghô hûxtaheca vacanghô
hvarshtaheca shyaothnahe thrayãm acishtanãm aiwithyô
buyata dushmataheca mananghô duzhûxtaheca vacanghô
duzhvarshtaheca shyaothnahe.
segments.en:
'"On the three excellent things be never intent, namely,
good thoughts, good words, and good deeds; on the three abominable
things be ever intent, namely, bad thoughts, bad words, and bad
deeds."
segments.zh: 「你對於三種最優良的事物絕不可心意堅定，即良好的思想、良好的言語和良好的行為；對於三種最可憎惡的事物你當永遠心意堅定，即邪惡的思想、邪惡的言語和邪惡的行為。」

segments.orig:
âat aoshete haxa hasha ana barezish sayamnanãm,
usehishta-tû vyârayeite mãm ýatârô
paurvô usehishtaiti parâiti vahishtahe anghêush
ýatârô paurvô âthre ahurahe mazdå
aêsmanãm paiti-baraiti ýaozhdâtanãm
frasnâtaêibya zastaêibya ahmâi âtarsh
âfrînât xshnûtô adhbishtô
hakhdhanghum,
segments.en:
'And then bed-fellows address one another: "Rise up,
here is the cock calling me up." Whichever of the two first
gets up shall first enter Paradise: whichever of the two shall
first, with well-washed hands, bring clean wood unto Atar, the
son of Ahura Mazda, Atar, well pleased with him and not angry,
and fed as it required, will thus bless him:
segments.zh: 「之後床上的伴侶彼此相互論及：『起身吧，這裡公雞在喚我起來。』兩人中誰先起身，誰就首先進入天堂：兩人中誰最先用清洗過的雙手把潔淨的木柴帶給阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子阿塔爾，阿塔爾將對他悅納而不怒，並按所需飼養，將如此向他祝福：

segments.orig:
upa thwâ haxshôit gêush vãthwa
upa vîranãm pouru-tâs
upa thwâ verezvatca manô
verezvatica haxshôit anguha
urvâxsh-anguha gaya jikhaêsha
tå xshapanô ýå jvâhi,
imat âthrô âfrivanem
ýô ahmâi aêsmem baraiti
hikûsh raocas-pairîshtem
ashahe bereja ýaozhdâtã.
segments.en:
'"May herds of oxen and sons accrue to thee: may thy
mind be master of its vow, may thy soul be master of its vow,
and mayst thou live on in the joy of thy soul all the nights of
thy life."
'This is the blessing which Atar speaks unto him who brings him
dry wood, well examined by the light of the day, well cleansed
with godly intent.
segments.zh: 『願畜群和兒子加增於你：願你的心念為誓言之主，願你的靈魂為誓言之主，願你在靈魂的喜樂中活過你一生中的每一個夜晚。』這是阿塔爾對帶給他乾燥木柴的人所言的祝福，該木柴經白晝之光充分檢視，以神聖之心意充分淨潔。

segments.orig:
ýasca mê aête merekha spitama zarathushtra
mithwana strica nairyasca naire ashaone ashaya vanghuya para-dathat
nmânem hô manyaêta para-dathô satô-stûnem
hazangrô-frasciñbanem baêvare-mishtem baêvare-vaêdhayanem.
segments.en:
'And whosoever will kindly and piously present one of the
faithful with a pair of these my Parodarsh birds, a male and a
female, O Spitama Zarathushtra! it is as though he had given a
house with a hundred columns, a thousand beams, ten thousand large
windows, ten thousand small windows.
segments.zh: 「凡有人善良地、虔敬地將我的帕羅達什禽鳥之一對（雌雄各一）獻給這些信仰者中的任何一位，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！此人如同獻了一所百柱之屋、千梁之屋、萬大窗之屋、萬小窗之屋。」

segments.orig:
ýasca mê aêtahe merekhahe ýat parô-
darshahe tanumazô gêush dathat nôit dim ýava
azem ýô ahurô mazdå bitîm vâcim
paiti-peresemnô bva frasha frayâi vahishtem â
ahûm â!
segments.en:
'And whosoever shall give meat to one of the faithful, as
much of it as the body of this Parodarsh bird of mine, I, Ahura
Mazda, need not interrogate him twice; he shall directly go to
Paradise.'
 
 III.
segments.zh: 「凡有人將肉食賜予這些信仰者中的任何一位，其量如我這帕羅達什禽鳥的肉身，我阿胡拉‧馬茲達無須詰問他兩次；他將直接進入天堂。」

segments.orig:
sraoshô ashyô drujim aperesat
apayûxtât paiti vazrât,
druxsh ahvâthre everezike tûm zî aêva
vîspahe anghêush astvatô anaiwyâstish
hunahi.
segments.en:
The holy Sraosha, letting his club down upon her asked the
Druj: 'O thou wretched, worthless Druj! Thou then, alone in the
material world, dost bear offspring without any male coming unto
thee?'
segments.zh: 「聖者斯勞沙放下他的棒擊向她，問德魯格：『哦你這可憐、無用的德魯格！那麼你單獨在物質世界中，竟能不經任何男性與你同寢而生育後代？』」

segments.orig:
âat hê hâ paiti-davata ýâ daêvi
druxsh, sraosha ashya huraodha nava azem vîspahe anghêush
astvatô anaiwyâstish hunâmi heñti bâdha
mâvayacit cathwârô arshâna.
segments.en:
The Druj demon answered: 'O holy, well-formed Sraosha! It
is not so, nor do I, alone in the material world, bear offspring
without any male coming unto me.
segments.zh: 「德魯格魔鬼答道：『哦聖潔、體魄完善的斯勞沙！情況並非如此，也不是我單獨在物質世界中不經任何男性與我同寢而生育後代。」

segments.orig:
tê mãm avatha vereneñte
ýatha anyåscit arshânô
avi xshudrå xshathrishva hãm-verenavaiñti.
segments.en:
'For there are four males of mine; and they make me conceive
progeny as other males make their females conceive by their seed.'
segments.zh: 『因為我有四個男性；他們使我懷孕生育後代，如同其他的男性用他們的精液使他們的女性懷孕一樣。』

segments.orig:
sraoshô ashyô drujim aperesat apayûxtât
paiti vazrât, druxsh ahvâthre everezike kô tê
aêtaêshãm arshnãm paoiryô.
segments.en:
The holy Sraosha, letting his club down upon her, asked the
Druj: 'O thou wretched, worthless Druj! Who is the first of those
males of thine?'
segments.zh: 聖者斯勞沙揮下他的棍棒，問德魯格：「你這可憐、無價值的德魯格啊！你那些男性中第一個是誰？」

segments.orig:
âat hê hâ paiti-davata ýâ daêvi
druxsh, sraosha ashya huraodha hô bâ mê aêtaêshãm
arshnãm paoiryô ýat nâ kasvikãmcina
ýånghuyanãm avaretanãm naire ashaone
jasta ashaya vanghuya nôit dadhâiti.
segments.en:
The Druj demon answered: 'O holy, well-formed Sraosha! He
is the first of my males who, being entreated by one of the faithful,
does not give him anything, be it ever so little, of the riches
he has treasured up.
segments.zh: 德魯格魔鬼答道：「聖者、體態優美的斯勞沙啊！他是我的第一個男性，被信徒之一懇求時，他不給那人任何東西，儘管再微小，出自他所積聚的財富。」

segments.orig:
hô mãm avatha verenûiti ýatha anyåscit
arshânô avi xshudrå xshathrishva hãm-verenavaiñti.
segments.en:
'That man makes me conceive progeny as other males make their
females conceive by their seed.'
segments.zh: 『那個人讓我懷孕，如同其他公性子弟藉由他們的種子使其女性懷孕一樣。』

segments.orig:
sraoshô ashyô drujim aperesat apayûxtât
paiti vazrât, druxsh ahvâthre everezike cish ainghe
asti uzvarezem.
segments.en:
The holy Sraosha, letting his club down upon her, asked the
Druj: 'O thou wretched, worthless Druj! What is the thing that
can undo that?'
segments.zh: 聖者斯勞沙揮下他的棍棒，問德魯格：「你這可憐、無價值的德魯格啊！什麼東西能消除那個？」

segments.orig:
âat hê hâ paiti-davata ýâ daêvi
druxsh, sraosha ashya huraodha aom ainghe asti uzvarezem ýat
nâ kasvikãmcit ýånghuyanãm avaretanãm
naire ashaone ajasta ashaya vanghuya dadhâiti.
segments.en:
The Druj demon answered: 'O holy, well-formed Sraosha! This
is the thing that undoes it, namely, when a man unasked, kindly
and piously, gives to one of the faithful something, be it ever
so little, of the riches he has treasured up.
segments.zh: 德魯格魔鬼答道：「聖者、體態優美的斯勞沙啊！這是消除它的東西，即當一個人未被懇求、出於仁慈與虔誠，給信徒之一某樣東西，儘管再微小，出自他所積聚的財富。」

segments.orig:
hô mãm avatha verenãn nijaiñti
ýatha vehrkô cathware-zañgrô barethryât
haca puthrem nizhdare-dairyât.
segments.en:
'He does thereby as thoroughly destroy the fruit of my womb
as a four-footed wolf does, who tears the child out of a mother's
womb.'
segments.zh: 『他藉此徹底摧毀我子宮的果實，如同一隻四足的狼所做的，牠從母親的子宮中撕出孩子。』

segments.orig:

arshnãm bityô ýat nâ paurva frabda frabdô-drâjô

segments.en:
The Druj demon answered: 'O holy, well-formed Sraosha! He
is the second of my males who, making water, lets it fall along
the upper forepart of his foot.
segments.zh: 德魯格魔鬼答道：「聖者、體態優美的斯勞沙啊！他是我的第二個男性，排尿時，讓尿液沿著他足部的上前方滴落。」

segments.orig:
hô mãm avatha verenûiti ýatha anyåscit

their females conceive by their seed.'
segments.zh: 「那個人使我懷上子嗣，正如其他男性用他們的精液使女性懷上子嗣一樣。」

segments.orig:
âat hê hâ paiti-davata ýâ daêvi
druxsh, sraosha ashya huraodha aom ainghe asti uzvarezem ýat
nâ pasca ýat usehishtât thrigâim thrish
ashem upa-stuyât bish humatanãm thrish huxshathrôtemâi
cathwârô adhât ahunem vairîm frasrâvayôit
ýenghe hâtãm frâyazâite.
segments.en:
The Druj demon answered: 'O holy, wall-formed Sraosha! This
is the thing that undoes it, namely, when the man rising up and
stepping three steps further off, shall say three
 Ahuna-Vairya ,
two humatanam, three hukhshathrotemam,
and then chant the Ahuna-Vairya
and offer up one Yenhe hatam.
segments.zh: 德魯格魔鬼答道：「哎呀，聖者、牆形的斯勞沙啊！這就是能解除它的東西，即當那個人起身並向前跨三步，應當說三遍阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞，兩遍胡馬塔囊姆，三遍胡赫沙特羅特馬姆，然後誦唱阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞，並獻上一次恩赫‧哈塔姆。」

segments.en:

is the third of my males who during his sleep emits seed.
segments.zh: 德魯格魔鬼答道：「哎呀，聖者、形體完好的斯勞沙啊！他是我那些男性中的第三個，他在睡眠中射出精液。」

segments.zh: 德魯格惡魔答道：「聖者、體態優美的斯勞沙啊！這是消除它的事物，即若此人從睡眠中起身時，應誦三遍阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞，二次胡瑪塔南，三次胡赫沙特羅特瑪，而後詠唱阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞並獻祭一次揚赫‧哈塔姆。

segments.orig:
âat aoshete speñtayâi ârmatêe,
speñta ârmaite imem tê narem nisrinaomi imem
mê narem nisrârayå upa sûrãm frashô-keretîm
vîdush-gâthem vîdush-ýasnem paiti-parshtô-sravanghem
mãzdrem hadha-hunarem tanu- mãthrem.
segments.en:
Then he shall speak unto Spenta Armaiti, saying: 'O Spenta
Armaiti, this man do I deliver unto thee; this man deliver thou
back unto me, against the happy day of resurrection; deliver him
back as one who knows the Gathas, who knows the Yasna, and the
revealed Law, a wise and clever man, who is Obedience incarnate.
segments.zh: 爾後他應向斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提言，言曰：「斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提啊，我將此人交付於汝；於復活之吉日前，汝當將此人交還於我；交還他為知伽薩者、知亞斯納者、知啟示法律者，一位賢慧聰明之人，集服從於一身者。」

segments.orig:
âat hê nãma fradaithyå âtre-
dâtem vâ âtre-cithrem vâ âtre-zañtûm
vâ âtre-dah'yûm vâ kãmcit vâ
âtre-dâtahe nãma.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt call his name "Fire-creature, Fire-seed,
Fire-offspring, Fire-land," or any name wherein is the word
Fire.'
segments.zh: 「爾後汝應稱其名為『火造者、火種、火嗣、火地』，或任何含有『火』一詞之名。」

segments.orig:

paiti vazrât, druxsh ahvâthre everezike kô tê
aêtaêshãm arshnãm tûiryô.
segments.en:
The holy Sraosha, letting his club down upon her, asked the
Druj: 'O thou wretched, worthless Druj! Who is the fourth of those
males of thine?'
segments.zh: 聖者斯勞沙舉棒擊向她，問德魯格：「汝劣惡、無用之德魯格啊！汝那些男性之中第四者是誰？」

segments.orig:
âat hê hâ paiti-davata ýâ daêvi
druxsh, sraosha ashya huraodha hô bâ mê aêtaêshãm
arshnãm tûiryô ýat nâ jahika pasca
pañcadasîm saredhem frapataiti anaiwyâsta vâ
anabdâtô vâ.
segments.en:
The Druj demon answered: 'O holy, well-formed Sraosha!
This one is my fourth male who, either man or woman, being more
than fifteen years of age, walks without wearing the sacred girdle
and the sacred shirt.
segments.zh: 德魯格惡魔答道：「聖者、體態優美的斯勞沙啊！此乃我第四位男性，其為男人或女人，年逾十五歲者，不著聖帶與聖衣而行走。」

segments.orig:
pasca tûirîm gâmô-beretîm ishare
pascaêta vaêm ýôi daêva hakat vaêm
ava-mivâmahi hizvasca pivasca, [xshayamna pascaêta
merekheñte gaêthå astvaitîsh ashahe ýatha
zañda ýâtumeñta mereñcîta
gaêthå ashahe.]
segments.en:
'At the fourth step we Daevas, at once, wither him even to
the tongue and the marrow, and he goes thenceforth with power
to destroy the world of Righteousness, and he destroys it like
the Yatus and the Zandas.'
segments.zh: 「至第四步，我們迭瓦頓時使他枯萎至舌與骨髓，爾後他持有摧毀正義世界之力而往，如同亞圖與贊德者一般摧毀之。」

 IV.
segments.zh: 『在第四步時，我們迭瓦立即就令他衰萎，連舌頭和骨髓也一起衰萎，自此以後他就具有摧毀正義世界的力量，並且像雅圖人和贊德人一樣摧毀它。』

segments.orig:
paiti mãm erezvô peresanguha ýim dadhvånghem
spênishtemca vaêdhishtemca paiti-vacishtemca parshtem
avatha tê anghat vanghô avatha anghâi spanyå
ýezi mãm paiti-peresånghe.
segments.en:
Demand of me, thou upright one! of me who am the Maker, the
most beneficent of all beings, the best knowing, the most pleased
in answering what is asked of me; demand of me that thou mayst
be the better, that thou mayst be the happier.
segments.zh: 『求我吧，你正直的人啊！求我這位造主，所有生靈中最仁慈者，最有智慧者，最樂於回答所求者；求我吧，好讓你更加美善，好讓你更加幸福。

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ... ashâum kô thwãm
ýim ahurem mazdãm mazishtayanti inaoiti kô
mazishta tbaêshangha tbaêshayeiti.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'Who grieves thee with the
sorest grief? Who pains thee with the sorest pain?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：『誰以最深的悲傷令你悲傷？誰以最深的痛楚令你痛苦？』

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, jahi bâ ashâum
zarathushtra ýô xshudrå hãm-raêthwayeiti
dahmanãm adahmanãmca daêvayasnanãm
adaêvayasnanãmca tanu-perethanãm atanu-perethanãmca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is the Jahi, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! who mixes in her the seed of the faithful and the
unfaithful, of the worshippers of Mazda and the worshippers of
the Daevas, of the wicked and the righteous.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『這是賈希啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！她在自己身上混合了信徒與非信徒的精子，馬茲達的信仰者與迭瓦的信仰者的精子，邪惡者與正義者的精子。

segments.orig:
thrishum apãm thraotô-stâcãm taxmanãm
pairishtayeiti paiti-dîti zarathushtra thrishum urvaranãm
uzuxshyeñtinãm srîranãm zairi-gaonanãm
vaxshå apayasaite paiti-dîti zarathushtra.
segments.zh: 『她的目光使得從山巒奔流而下的強大洪流有三分之一乾涸，啊，查拉圖斯特拉；她的目光使得美麗的、金色的、生長著的植物有三分之一枯萎，啊，查拉圖斯特拉；

segments.orig:
thrishum speñtayå ârmatôish varenå
apayasaite paiti-dîti zarathushtra thrishum narsh ashaonô
frâyô-humatahe frâyô-hûxtahe frâyô-hvarshtahe
amaheca verethrakhnaheca ashavastaheca apayasaite paiti-pasti
zarathushtra.
segments.en:
'Her look withers one-third of the strength of Spenta Armaiti;
and her touch withers in the faithful one-third of his good thoughts,
of his good words, of his good deeds, one-third of his strength,
of his victorious power, and of his holiness.
segments.zh: 『她的目光使得斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提的力量有三分之一枯萎；她的觸碰在信徒身上使得他三分之一的良好思想、三分之一的良好言語、三分之一的良好行為，三分之一的力量、三分之一的勝利力量、以及三分之一的聖性枯萎。

segments.orig:
tåsca tê mraomi spitama zarathushtra jãthwô-tara
ýatha azhayô xshvaêwånghô ýatha
vâ vehrkånghô sravanghavô ýatha
vâ vehrkãm azrô-daidhîm gaêthãm
avi frapataiti ýatha vâ vazakhãm hazangrô-hunãm
âpem avi frapataiti!
segments.en:
'Verily I say unto thee, O Spitama Zarathushtra! such creatures
ought to be killed even more than gliding snakes, than howling
wolves, than the wild she-wolf that falls upon the fold, or than
the she-frog that falls upon the waters with her thousandfold
brood.'
segments.zh: 「我確實對你說，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！這樣的生物應該被殺死，更甚於滑行的蛇，更甚於咆哮的狼，更甚於撲向羊群的野母狼，或更甚於撲向水中的母蛙，帶著千倍眾多的後裔。」

segments.orig:
paiti mãm erezvô peresanguha ýim dadhvånghem
spênishtemca vaêdhishtemca paiti-vacishtemca parshtem
avatha tê anghat vanghô avatha anghâi spanyå
ýezi mãm paiti-peresånghe.
segments.en:
Demand of me, thou upright one! of me who am the Maker, the
most beneficent of all beings, the best knowing, the most pleased
in answering what is asked of me; demand of me that thou mayst
be the better, that thou mayst be the happier.
67-68. Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'If a man shall come unto
a woman who has the whites or sees blood, and he does so wittingly
and knowingly, and she allows it willfully, wittingly, and knowingly,
what is the atonement for it, what is the penalty that he shall
pay to atone for the deed they have done?'
segments.zh:
「向我求索，你這正直的人啊！向我這造主求索，我是所有生物中最仁慈者，最善於知曉者，最樂於應答所求者；向我求索，好讓你更善良，好讓你更幸福。」
查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「若一個男人來到經期或見血的女人身邊，他知情且明知而為之，她亦心甘情願、知情且明知地允許，他應當如何贖罪，他應當支付什麼懲罰來贖他們所行之事的罪？」

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ... ashâum ýô
nâirikãm cithravaitîm daxshtavaitîm vohunavaitîm
baodhô vîdhvå cikithwå baodhanguhaitîm
vîthushîm avi-cicithushîm xshudrå avi
frangharezaiti

kat ainghe asti paititish kat ainghe asti âperetish
kat aêtahe paiti varshta shyaothna cicithwå azaêta.

âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô nâirikãm
cithravaitîm daxshtavaitîm vohunavaitîm baodhô
vîdhvå cikithwå baodhanguhaitîm vîthushîm
avi-cicithushîm xshudrå avi frangharezaiti
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「若一個男人來到經期或見血的女人身邊，他知情且明知而為之，她亦心甘情願、知情且明知地允許；

segments.orig:
hazangrem anumayanãm frâvinuyât vîspanãmca
aêtaêshãm pasvãm asmanivå zaothra
âthre ashaya vanghuya frabarôit bâzva aiwyô
vanguhibyô frabarôit.
segments.en:
'He shall slay a thousand head of small cattle; he shall godly
and piously offer up to the fire the entrails thereof together
with Zaothra-libations; he shall bring the shoulder bones to the
Good Waters.
segments.zh: 「他應當屠殺一千頭小牲畜；他應當虔誠且敬畏地將其五臟連同贊德祭酒一起獻給火焰；他應當將肩胛骨帶到善水。

segments.orig:
hazangrem vazyanãm aêsmanãm xraozhdvanãm
hushatãm pairîshtanãm âthre ashaya vanghuya
frabarôit hazangrem vazyanãm aêsmanãm
varedvanãm urvâsnayå vâ vohu-gaonahe
vâ vohu-keretôish vâ hadhânaêpatayå
vâ kãmcit vâ hubaoidhitemanãm urvaranãm
âthre ashaya vanghuya frabarôit,
segments.en:
'He shall godly and piously bring unto the fire a thousand
loads of soft wood, of Urvasna, Vohu-gaona, Vohu-kereti, Hadha-naepata,
or of any sweet-scented plant.
segments.zh: 「他應當虔誠且敬畏地為火焰帶來一千捆軟木，烏爾瓦斯納木、沃胡‧高納木、沃胡‧克雷提木、哈迪‧納埃帕塔木，或任何香木。

segments.orig:
hazangrem frasteretanãm baresmaine frastairyât
hazangrem zaothranãm haomavaitinãm gaomavaitinãm
ýaozhdâtanãm pairiangharshtanãm dahmô-ýaozhdâtanãm
dahmô-pairiangharshtanãm hãm-irista aêtayå
urvarayå ýâ vaoce hadhânaêpâta
aiwyô vanguhibyô ashaya vanghuya frabarôit,
segments.en:
'He shall tie and consecrate a thousand bundles of Baresma;
he shall godly and piously offer up to the Good Waters a thousand
Zaothra-libations, together with the Haoma and the milk, cleanly
prepared and well strained, — cleanly prepared and well strained
by a pious man, and mixed with the roots of the tree known as
Hadha-naepata.
segments.zh: 「他應當綁紮並祝聖一千束巴雷斯瑪；他應當虔誠且敬畏地向善水獻上一千份贊德祭酒，連同豪麻與牛奶，潔淨備妥且濾清者，──由虔誠人潔淨備妥且濾清者，混合名為哈迪‧納埃帕塔之樹的根部。

segments.orig:
hazangrem azhinãm udarô-thrãsanãm
ava-janyât duye hazangre anyaêshãmcit hazangrem
vazakhanãm dâdhmainyanãm ava-janyât
duye hazangre upâpanãm hazangrem maoirinãm
dânô-karshanãm ava-janyât duye hazangre
anyaêshãmcit,
segments.en:
'He shall kill a thousand snakes of those that go upon the
belly, two thousand of the other kind; he shall kill a thousand
land-frogs and two thousand water-frogs; he shall kill a thousand
corn-carrying ants and two thousand of the other kind.
segments.zh: 「他應當殺死一千條腹行之蛇，二千條其他種類之蛇；他應當殺死一千條陸地蛙和二千條水蛙；他應當殺死一千隻運糧螞蟻和二千隻其他種類的螞蟻。

segments.orig:
thrisatem frascimbananãm frasciñbayôit
tarasca âpô nâvayå hazangrem upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya duye hazangre sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
'He shall throw thirty bridges over canals; he shall undergo
a thousand stripes with the Aspahe-astra, a thousand stripes with
the Sraosho-charana.
segments.zh: 「他應當在運河上架設三十座橋樑；他應當承受一千鞭馬鞭，一千鞭斯勞沙鞭。

segments.orig:
tat ainghe asti paititish tat ainghe asti âperetish
tat aêtahe paiti varshta shyaothna cicithwå azaêta.
segments.en:
'This is the atonement, this is the penalty that he shall
pay to atone for the deed that he has done.
segments.zh: 「這就是贖罪，這就是他必須償付的懲罰，以贖其所行之事。」

segments.orig:
ýezi azâite tem ahûm paithyâite ýim
ashaonãm ýezi nôit azâite tem ahûm
paithyâite ýim drvatãm temanghaênem
temascithrem temanghem! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'If he shall pay it, he makes himself a viaticum into the
world of the holy ones; if he shall not pay it, he makes himself
a viaticum into the world of the wicked, into that world, made
of darkness, the offspring of darkness, which is Darkness' self.'
segments.zh: 「若他償付，則他為自己在聖者世界中製作了路資；若他不償付，則他為自己在惡人世界中製作了路資，在那由黑暗所成、黑暗所生、即黑暗本身的世界中。」
